reviews.t: Removes mascara and eyeliner imperfections, perfectly
reviews.x: One of my must have make up products. It removes mess-ups of mascara and eyeliner.

I have been searching for something like this because q-tips weren't cutting it! It helps you get that perfect eyeliner line with out smudging. I really like that it comes with extra tips. I will definitely be buying more of these in the future!

I have been searching for something like this. I freehand my make up and I don't always have the time to be extra careful with my lines when I'm running late in the morning so this is perfect to clean up my mistakes. I would not suggest this to someone that needs a lot of clean up because the brush head is not meant for that. Also, I've taken the advice of others and cleaned the tip right after wiping something off. The bottom has three extra tips for future use. I think this is going to last me

I love every thing about this MasterFixer, EXCEPT for the fact that when I attempted to switch off the old tip for the new one (I used the first tip for approximately 3 months, the remaining tips had all dried up and were useless to me.  I am reordering, but this time I will switch off tips on a 3-4 week basis.

reviews.t: Great for precisely removing makeup mishaps
reviews.x: Exactly what I was looking for! I used to use the ELF makeup remover pen and this is basically the same. Love that it comes with replacement heads because if you use it to clean up mascara and eyeliner like I do it can get stained.

I’ve used many types of correcting pens and this is the best yet. Fine enough tip for tight spaces. Wipes off tip easily for reuse. Best part, it comes with multiple replacement tips. Light weight, easy to fit into your makeup bag or purse. Only very mildly oily and easy to reapply over corrected area. I’ve bought several and will purchase more!
I will never be without this product when I am applying any eye make up!

I don't know what I'd do without this product. It instantly(well almost) removes that fleck of mascara off your cheek or under your eye. Eye shadow, no problem. It is truly magic and I love it. I'll always buy this product and you should too.  And it costs no more than if you bought it at Wal Mart, which has stopped stocking the product.

The only product I’ve found that can get makeup mistakes that are in tight spots. It’s very precise and gets all my mistakes n mishaps quickly so i can fix it n not have to redo all my makeup in the process. Great lil tool i carry with me.

Had an eye makeup corrector stick from Avon that I'd had for years. It suddenly disappeared. (I suspect that my daughter "borrowed" it.) I searched high and low for a replacement, but to no avail. Finally searched on Amazon and found this Maybelline version. It fits the bill. It is more liquid or softer than I'm used to. I like that it has replacement tips. It's larger than my previous pen, but that's okay.

reviews.t: Wow!  How come I just found this product?!
reviews.x: I used to be a master at applying liquid (brush) eyeliner. Well, I've gotten a bit older, have developed bad eyesight, and collected a few wrinkles along the way.  Now, once applied, my eyeliner looks just fine.  Until I check again with my glasses.  A 3 year-old could do better!  This eraser easily fixes your application so you don't have to wash it off and start sll over again.  What a great product!

reviews.t: A life saver when your hand twitches.
reviews.x: You only need to use the very tip very lightly to clean up little mistakes. Works very well and has saved me a lot of swearing. Only downside is that you really need a q-tip or something to wipe off excess, otherwise your edges get a little blurred throughout the day, or you can't re-apply over the same spot to sharpen it back up without it going on kind of funky.

reviews.t: Great quality, affordable, andromeda with  replacements :)
reviews.x: I’ve used a few of these and this one is great and very affordable. Is comes with replacements? I didn’t even catch that! Best surprise when I opened up my package. These usually aren’t cheap, so the fact that these have replacements is a huge plus. For that reason, I will continue to purchase aside from the fact that they’re great quality.

Item just arrived today, date of manufacture is said to be Dec 2017 (more than 3 years ago), with a general shelf life of 36 months, so in other words, I basically got an expired item(?)  Haven't tried it yet, cause I decided to come and write this review.

I absolutely love this product.  It I'd perfect for cleaning up and getting sharp edge on eyeliner.  The problem is that you have to buy online.  Why don't other brands sell something like this?  Missed opportunity.

This thing saves me every time! I have arthritis in my hands, and always manage to mess up my eyeliner. This thing removes smudges, smears or even plain old mistakes in seconds. Worth every penny. It's great.

Used to buy it at Walmart then nobody knew what I was talking about, thank goodness for Amazon. It is so easy to use and it really clears up any little mistakes you might make when eyeliner or mascara.

reviews.t: Maybelline please don't ever stop making this.
reviews.x: This is really a good little tool. Maybelline and so many places end up doing away with the OG'S which is awful and sad. Things like this are so good to have this works great holds up wonderful.
This is a wonderful product for removing eyeliner or mascara that has gotten away with you while applying makeup.  I have used it for 2 years now and would not think of using anything else.
I love this product I only with the sold the tips to put on the pen separately so you didn’t have to buy the whole thing over again
I love this makeup remover pen. It works better than anything I have and makes it easy to remove my eye makeup.
Not many make-up correction pens on the market. This works great for eyeline smudges or mascara mistakes.
It's great for eye makeup smudge! Takes it off easy

Wasn’t to sure how this product would work when I ordered it, but after I tried it out, I wondered why I haven’t used this sooner. I absolutely love it. You barely have to touch the little mascara spot that got near or on your eye and like magic it’s gone.  I do gently wipe the tip against a wet wash cloth when I’m done to keep it sharp and clean, ready for the next time I need it. It comes with the extra tips too, which is great even though I haven’t had to replace mine yet. I highly recommend

reviews.t: Excellent Product! So glad I was able to find it again after stores discontinued/stopped selling it!
reviews.x: I absolutely love this product by maybelline! And I have been looking for this product forever! I used to be able to get it at Walmart but they no longer sell this product or have discontinued it. And that was the only retailer I have been able to find that product at and quite a while up until about 6 to 8 months ago when they discontinued/stopped selling it. so I was so incredibly happy when I found this on Amazon and I was able to purchase this product again by Maybelline! I absolutely love t

claims.text: Reviewers frequently praise it for precisely cleaning up mascara and eyeliner mistakes.
Many reviewers appreciate that it comes with multiple replacement tips.
Some reviewers note the replacement tips can dry out or become useless if not swapped in time.
A few reviewers mention needing a q-tip or something to wipe off excess product to avoid blurred edges.
One reviewer reported receiving an item that appeared expired based on its manufacture date.
